tagline: We move money in all the ways the world depends on.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Money Transfer segment, representing 42% of revenue, is the company's primary growth driver, supported by Ria Money Transfer and Xe.

kpis.name: Money Transfer Segment Revenue Contribution
kpis.explanation: Percentage of consolidated revenue derived from international money transfer and foreign exchange services.
kpis.description: This segment represents the largest portion of Euronet's consolidated revenue, primarily driven by transaction fees and foreign exchange margins.
kpis.signal: The most significant segment of the company.

kpis.name: Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) Segment Revenue Contribution
kpis.explanation: Percentage of consolidated revenue from automated teller machine (ATM) and point-of-sale (POS) terminal services.
kpis.description: This segment covers revenue from ATMs and POS terminals, as well as transaction processing and value-added services.
kpis.signal: Stable revenue base through physical networks.

kpis.name: epay Segment Revenue Contribution
kpis.explanation: Percentage of consolidated revenue from retail payment solutions and digital content distribution.
kpis.description: This segment generates revenue through commissions on digital content distribution and retail payment solutions.

kpis.name: Point-of-Sale (POS) Terminals
kpis.explanation: Total number of point-of-sale terminals operated by the company.
kpis.description: POS terminals are used for payment processing, including prepaid services and digital content.
kpis.signal: Extensive physical network for retail transactions.

kpis.name: Automated Teller Machines (ATMs)
kpis.explanation: Total number of automated teller machines operated by the company.
kpis.description: ATMs are used for basic banking services and transactions, managed by Euronet for financial institutions.
kpis.signal: Key infrastructure for basic financial services.

kpis.name: Number of Operating Countries
kpis.explanation: Number of countries where the company operates its services.
kpis.description: The company operates in numerous countries, particularly through its epay segment, demonstrating a broad international footprint.

kpis.name: Digital Media Content Revenue Mix in epay
kpis.explanation: Percentage of epay segment revenue derived from digital media content.
kpis.description: Digital media content now represents the majority of epay segment revenue, indicating a successful adaptation to market trends.
kpis.signal: Successful transition to digital content within the epay segment.

risks.title: Significant foreign exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: Foreign exchange risk is significant, with approximately 76% of revenue generated outside the United States. Fluctuations in exchange rates can materially impact the company's operating results and financial condition.

risks.title: Interest rate risk on debt
risks.score_rationale: The company has total debt of $2,047.3 million, of which $24.6 million is variable rate (Credit Facility). A 1% increase in interest rates would result in approximately $19 million of additional interest expense. This risk is moderate.

risks.title: Risk related to CoreCard acquisition
risks.score_rationale: The acquisition of CoreCard in 2025 presents potential integration risk. Management has excluded CoreCard's internal control from its assessment, suggesting potential risk related to integration and financial control of this new entity.

risks.title: Audit risk on sufficiency of revenue evidence
risks.score_rationale: The sufficiency of audit evidence on revenue has been identified as a critical audit matter. The geographic dispersion and complexity of operations require subjective judgments, indicating a potential risk of inaccurate revenue reporting.

risks.title: Risk related to non-designated derivative instruments
risks.score_rationale: The company uses derivative instruments to manage foreign exchange risk but does not systematically account for them as hedging instruments. This means gains and losses are recorded directly in earnings, increasing volatility.

ai_positioning.summary: The company EEFT does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
